# Midland Eye

> Midland Eye is a private eye clinic at 50 Lode Lane, Solihull, West Midlands, B91 2AW, United Kingdom.
> Telephone 0121 711 2020. Open 7 days a week (weekdays 8am–8pm, weekends 8am–4pm).
> Consultant-delivered eye surgery and treatment with no waiting times, 0% finance options and one
> year of free aftercare on select procedures.

## Treatments
- [Laser Eye Surgery](https://midlandeye.com/laser-eye-surgery): LASIK, LASEK and PRK
- [Cataract Surgery](https://midlandeye.com/cataract-surgery): standard phacoemulsification and LENSAR laser-assisted
- [Laser Cataract Surgery](https://midlandeye.com/laser-cataract-surgery): femtosecond laser-assisted cataract surgery
- [Clear Lens Exchange](https://midlandeye.com/clear-lens-exchange): lens replacement surgery
- [EVO ICL](https://midlandeye.com/evo-icl-lens-exchange): implantable contact lens for those unsuitable for laser
- [Cosmetic Eye Surgery](https://midlandeye.com/cosmetic-eye-surgery): oculoplastic and eyelid procedures
- [Glaucoma](https://midlandeye.com/glaucoma): diagnosis, drops, SLT laser and surgical options
- [Diabetic Retinopathy](https://midlandeye.com/diabetic-retinopathy-treatment)
- [Keratoconus](https://midlandeye.com/keratoconus-treatment): corneal cross-linking and graft surgery
- [Macular Degeneration](https://midlandeye.com/macular-degeneration): wet and dry AMD assessment and treatment
- [Retinal Detachment](https://midlandeye.com/retinal-detachment): urgent assessment and vitrectomy

## People
- [Consultants & Specialists](https://midlandeye.com/consultants-and-specialist-page): 14 NHS-trained consultant ophthalmologists, Fellows of the Royal College of Ophthalmologists
